info.name: Weavr Multi Product BackOffice Access Token Managed Cards API
Managed Cards
Get a managed card

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a card.

items.docs: Returns all details of the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Update a managed card

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a card.

items.docs: Update the details of the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Update a managed card's renewal type

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a card.

items.docs:
Update the renewal type of the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

Please contact our support team or your account manager to request access to this endpoint.

info.name: Remove a managed card

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a managed card.

items.docs:
Destroys the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter. Unlike block, this action is not reversible.

A managed card must be empty before it can be destroyed using this operation.

info.name: Block a managed card

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a managed card.

items.docs: Blocks the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter. This is a reversible action and the card can be unblocked using the _managedCardUnblock_ operation.

info.name: Unblock a managed card

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the managed card.

items.docs:
Unblocks the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.
The managed card must have `state.blockedReason` as `USER` so that it can be unblocked.
If the managed card was blocked by `SYSTEM`, users cannot unblock it.

info.name: Get all spend rules for a managed card

items.docs: Fetch the list of spend rules associated with the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Create spend rules for a managed card

items.docs: Create the spend rules associated with the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Update spend rules for a managed card

items.docs: Must be user after a POST, to update individual spend rules associated with the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Delete all spend rules for a managed card

items.docs: Remove all spend rules associated with the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Get a managed card statement

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a managed card.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: orderByTimestamp
params.description:
Orders the result in ascending or descending order.
  - ASC: Ascending order, oldest transactions first.
  - DESC: Descending order, most recent transactions first.

If not specified, the transactions will be returned in descending order.

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description: Filter for transactions having transaction timestamp after `fromTimestamp`. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. If omitted, all matching transactions up to the present will be included.

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description: Filter for transactions having transaction timestamp before `toTimestamp`. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. If omitted, all matching transactions up to the present will be included. If both `fromTimestamp` and `toTimestamp` are provided, `toTimestamp` must be greater than `fromTimestamp`.

params.name: singleEntryPerTransaction
params.description:
Returns transactions that span multiple movements as a single entry.
Only includes transactions that have been completed.
Defaults to true for PDF statements, false otherwise.
Note: due to the fact that only completed transactions are included, some
transactions that are in progress and have modified the balance of the instrument
will not be shown, which could lead to seemingly inconsistent balance being displayed.

params.name: transactionType
params.description: Filter by the transaction type. Leave out to fetch all entries.

items.docs: Returns a list of transactions against the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter, matching the criteria provided in the request.

info.name: Get all managed cards

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: profileId
params.description: Filter by the managed account/card profile. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

params.name: friendlyName
params.description:
Filter by the managed account/card friendly name. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

The exact name must be provided, as wildcards are not supported.

params.name: currency
params.description:
Filter by the managed account/card currency.

Currencies are expressed as an ISO 4217 code. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by the type of the card.

params.name: renewalType
params.description: Filter by the renewal type of the card.

params.name: externalHandle
params.description: Search by the card's `externalHandle`.

params.name: cardNumberFirstSix
params.description: Filter by first six digits of the card.

params.name: cardNumberLastFour
params.description: Filter by last four digits of the card.

params.name: createdFrom
params.description: Filter for managed accounts/cards created after `createdFrom` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/cards.

params.name: createdTo
params.description: Filter for managed accounts/cards created before `createdTo` timestamp. Timestamp is expressed in Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/cards.

params.name: mode
params.description: Filter by card mode (prepaid mode or debit mode).

params.name: tag
params.description: Filter by the managed account/card tag. The exact tag must be provided, as wildcards are not supported. Leave out to fetch all managed accounts/card.

params.name: parentManagedAccountId
params.description: Filter by the Id of the parent managed account associated with the card. This is applicable only for debit mode cards.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

items.docs: Fetch cards matching the search criteria provided.

info.name: Create a managed card

items.docs:
Creates a managed card for the consumer or corporate identity.
The Managed Card Profile (configured in the Multi Portal) specified determines the behaviour and restrictions that the managed card will have.

info.name: Get transaction activity for a managed card

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the managed card.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by one or more transaction activity types.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by one or more normalised transaction statuses.

params.name: direction
params.description: Filter by transaction direction (CREDIT or DEBIT).

params.name: creationTimestampFrom
params.description: Filter for transactions created after this timestamp. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: creationTimestampTo
params.description: Filter for transactions created before this timestamp. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: lastUpdatedTimestampFrom
params.description: Filter for transactions last updated after this timestamp. Useful for pulling recently changed transactions. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: lastUpdatedTimestampTo
params.description: Filter for transactions last updated before this timestamp. Epoch timestamp using millisecond precision.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description:
Sort order for the results:
  - ASC: Ascending order, oldest first.
  - DESC: Descending order, most recent first.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort transaction activity results by. Defaults to `creationTimestamp`.

items.docs:
Returns all transactional activity on the managed card identified by the `id` path parameter.

This includes pending authorisations, completed settlements, refunds, and all other card transaction types
in a unified schema.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the managed card.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the transaction.

items.docs: Returns a specific transaction on the managed card.

info.name: Upgrade a card to physical

items.docs:
Upgrades the virtual card identified by the `id` path parameter to physical.

Before cards can be upgraded, a physical card programme must be set up and the card profile configuration updated accordingly.

info.name: Activate a physical card

items.docs: Activates the physical card identified by the `id` path paramter.

info.name: Get PIN for a physical card

items.docs: Retrieves the PIN of the physical card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Unblock PIN for a physical card

items.docs:
Physical cards can be marked as `pinBlocked` if there are too many failed PIN attempts.

Use this operation to unblock a PIN so that the card can be used again.

info.name: Replace a damaged physical card

items.docs: Report as damaged, and replace the physical card identified by the `id` path parameter.

info.name: Report a physical card as lost

items.docs: Report the physical card identified by the `id` path parameter as lost. This will deactivate the instrument and a new card will need to be requested.

info.name: Report a physical card as stolen

items.docs:
Report the physical card identified by the `id` path parameter as stolen. This will destroy the instrument and a new replacement card will need to be requested.

Once a replacement is requested, any funds remaining on this destroyed card will be transferred to the replacement card."

info.name: Replace a lost or stolen physical card

items.docs:
Issue a replacement for the physical card, identified by the `id` path parameter, that has already been reported as lost or stolen.

Any funds (that are not blocked pending a purchase for a previous authorisation) remaining on the card will be automatically transferred to the new replacement card.

info.name: Reset contactless limit for a physical card

items.docs:
For security purposes, the cardholder needs to provide the PIN after a number of contactless purchases. Use this operation to reset the physical card's contactless limit.
The contactless limit can only be reset for physical cards having the wearable form factor.
